Select Theme

    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Bishop
    Represents a Bishop chess piece ("wB" for White, "bB" for Black).
    Board
    Represents the 8x8 chessboard, manages piece placement, and renders the text-based board state to the console.
    Color
    Represents the two player colors in a standard game of chess.
    King
    Represents a King chess piece ("wK" for White, "bK" for Black).
    Knight
    Represents a Knight chess piece ("wN" for White, "bN" for Black).
    Pawn
    Represents a Pawn chess piece ("wp" for White, "bp" for Black).
    Piece
    Abstract base class representing a generic chess piece on the board.
    Position
    Represents a zero-indexed coordinate (row, column) on the 8x8 chessboard and provides conversion utilities for standard algebraic notation (e.g., "E2").
    Queen
    Represents a Queen chess piece ("wQ" for White, "bQ" for Black).
    Rook
    Represents a Rook chess piece ("wR" for White, "bR" for Black).
